skins.name: Gold Edition
skins.desc: The starter CRT recast in polished gold, with ruby knobs, diamond highlights and a little crown on the antenna.
skins.author: Kayboro

skins.name: Winter
skins.desc: The rabbit-ear CRT bundled up for a snow day, with a bobble hat, icicles and frost in the corners.
skins.author: Kayboro

skins.name: Midnight
skins.desc: Lottie stays up past bedtime in a starry midnight tank, with moonlit hair, glowing gills and golden night eyes.
skins.author: Kayboro

skins.name: Autumn
skins.desc: The old hollow tree in full autumn blaze, with pumpkins in the roots and leaves tumbling past your game.
skins.author: Kayboro

skins.name: Calico Night
skins.desc: The Neko TV dozing under a crescent moon in moonlit calico fur, with a midnight ribbon and glowing yarn.
skins.author: Kayboro

skins.name: Tuxedo
skins.desc: The Kitty Monitor dressed for a gala: black fur, white socks and bib, snowy whiskers and a red bow tie.
skins.author: Kayboro

skins.name: Gold Cabinet
skins.desc: A collector edition cabinet in black lacquer and gold, with a velvet marquee, jewel buttons and diamond studs.
skins.author: Kayboro

skins.name: Choco Bunny
skins.desc: The mochi bunny dipped in milk chocolate, with a white chocolate drizzle, sprinkles and its strawberry charm.
skins.author: Kayboro

skins.name: Haunted
skins.desc: The dungeon window after midnight: ghost-green torches, glowing runes, cobwebs, bats and a friendly ghost.
skins.author: Kayboro

skins.name: Night Market
skins.desc: The food truck works the night market shift: indigo paint, lantern-warm lights and a big red paper lantern on the roof.
skins.author: Kayboro
